summary: Package the opt-in web publisher as a Nix package and app

schema.detail: No wire or table schema change.

compatibility.detail: The package runs the existing upstream server with its existing WF_* configuration and pinned Node 24 runtime. Web assets remain an independent WF_DIST selection.

downtime.detail: Packaging does not activate or replace a running service.

manual.detail: No action required for existing installations. Publisher deployments opt in through the fractal-web-publisher package or app.

recovery.detail: Remove the opt-in package or select the prior publisher package; no data migration occurs.
